parsed.summary: The change adds a `do_not_call_in_templates` attribute to enumeration types to prevent them from being called in Django templates. This resolves the issue of enumeration types not being usable in templates.

issues.description: The change introduces a new attribute `do_not_call_in_templates` which is not aligned with the existing conventions in the Django codebase. It would be better to follow the existing style and naming conventions.
